verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect is a payments platform, and a platform of this kind could plausibly offer automations with versioning, review and rollback, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows automatic payout scheduling, no-code pricing tools, webhooks, a CLI and an MCP server. None of it documents versioning, reviewing or rolling back automation definitions, so these adjacent features earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
